description: Trane Technologies plc designs, manufactures, sells, and services of solutions for heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and custom and transport refrigeration. It offers air conditioners, exchangers, and handlers; airside and terminal devices; air sourced heat pumps;…
mda_take: FY2025 (10-K, filed 2026-02-05) net revenues rose 7.5% to $21,321.9M on 6.2% organic (3.2% volume + 3.0% price) plus M&A/FX; gross margin expanded 50 bps to 36.2% and operating margin 100 bps to 18.6% on productivity/price realization. Americas grew 8.0% (EBITDA margin +70 bps to 21.6%) and EMEA 9.6% (margin -150 bps on integration costs) while Asia Pacific fell 2.0% on China weakness; a Dec-22-2025 S&P upgrade to A-/A-1 followed. The standing overhang is the Aldrich/Murray asbestos Chapter 11 (Dec-17-2025 ruling streamlined liability estimation; first estimation hearing the week of Aug 10, 2026) plus two thin-cushion goodwill units (~$355M combined).
transcript_take: Q1 2026 (2026-04-30): adjusted EPS grew 7% YoY on 3% organic revenue (services double-digit), enterprise organic bookings +24% driving a record $10.7B backlog (+30% vs YE2025, ~$1B from Stellar Energy); Americas commercial HVAC bookings hit an all-time high (~+40%, applied +160%, third straight >100% applied quarter) and residential/transport both beat. Management RAISED FY2026 guidance to ~7% organic revenue and $14.75-$14.95 adjusted EPS and raised CapEx to 2-3% of revenue, citing 'even more conviction' on the second half. Offsets: an estimated $50M revenue/$0.05 EPS EMEA Middle-East hit and incremental tariff/commodity inflation running ahead of the January guide (enterprise price assumption raised from ~1.5 to ~2 pts).
